data.name: Marlin MXLR .308 ME Lever-Action Rifle
data.teaser: Port of the Marlin lever-action from EFT 1.0.
data.description:
Special thanks to the SPT devs for everything they’ve done for this game and its playerbase!

As of version 1.2.0, I believe everything is up to date except we are still missing accurate trader data, so I have only put in the MXLR trade at Jaeger 3 and the trades for the ammo at Mechanic and Jaeger.

Installation:

Download the .zip file, extract all, and drag and drop the contents into your root SPT install directory.

Uninstalling:

If for whatever reason you need to remove this mod, make sure you delete any new items that this mod adds from your inventory before you delete the mod folder!

versions.description:
Fixed/Added:
- Fixed compatibility with ODT's Item Info
- Added MXLR to Tarkov Shooter Quests
- Updated ru locale

If you are updating from version 1.0.0, please make sure to completely delete the original mod folder before installing this one!

Please let me know if you see any other errors.

## Updates/Fixes:

- Added to SBIH quest

- Added ability for other locales (ships with en & ru, defaults to en for all others but you can add custom locales in the same format as the other json files!)

- Added some items to traders (only main gun and ammo - still need trader data)

- Fixed formatting for Linux users (should be at least - let me know if not)

- Added mastery and presets

- Accurate handbook data

## Installation
**Please make sure to delete the old mod folder /SPT/user/mods/MC-MXLR/ before transferring the new folder over! Some files got renamed so it would be better to replace the whole folder just in case.**


## Other
I am not sure if this will fix the issue regarding ODT's Item Info; I apologize I ran out of time to try and tackle that issue, but hope to do so this week if this update does not fix it. Also I got a report that a testing profile was detecting stray items leftover from the old version of the mod, but I was not able to recreate that. Please report any issues you see in the comments.

Special thanks to:
- Kibb on Discord for the Linux fix & testing
- aklyashkin on Discord for the ru translation

Release version

Missing the following:

- Languages other than English
- Trader data - flea market only for now
- Accurate pricing
- Weapon mod compatibilities and conflicts with old items (probably none with the MXLR but not 100% sure)
- Weapon mastery and presets (including the default preset)

Please let me know if you find any errors!
